## Symptom
`verify` fails on a content check right after a deploy and passes minutes later with nothing redeployed (run:fixture-org/menuboard/7861204418, run:fixture-org/menuboard/7861391150).

## Root cause
Verify started one second after the deploy command returned, while the route still served the previous version. The three attempts answered 200 in about 40 ms with the old page, and `/__version` reported the commit deployed two days earlier (raw:20261021T140212Z-3c9d2e71). The new version took over the route 38 s later (issue:fixture-org/menuboard#41).

No request was slow, so this run was not a cold start, and the 30 s timeout with two retries did not change its outcome (run:fixture-org/menuboard/7861204418).

## Fix / workaround
Gate verify on identity: wait until `/__version` reports the sha being shipped, then run the content checks (issue:fixture-org/menuboard#41).

## How it is caught
An identity check on `/__version` fails with a sha mismatch while the old version serves, which tells this apart from a slow start (raw:20261021T140212Z-3c9d2e71). The re-run passed once the shipped sha was serving (raw:20261021T141130Z-a41f08b6).
